data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 165,799k (2016 - GBP 121,917k) is a deterioration of GBP 11,547k (2016 - deterioration of GBP 6,859k) to the claims reserves established at the prior year end, principally due to natural catastrophes (Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria and the Mexico earthquakes and Californian Wildfires) and adverse attritional development in prior year reserves on the Property and Marine classes.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Release on Liability class leading to favourable development

named_events.event_name: Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria and Mexico earthquakes
named_events.loss_description: net losses totalling $22,359k (GBP 16,546k); triggered reinstatement premium and acceleration of earning of catastrophe excess of loss protection
the Californian Wildfires further deteriorated the Property account with net losses incurred at the year end
improvement on the Liability class driven by the release of the 2016 Ogden margin

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 Jan 2017 were GBP 353.514m. Using the gross claims development table, the Syndicate shows a net gross prior-year strengthening of approximately GBP 21.0m (5.9% of opening reserves) at year end 2017. The deterioration/strengthening was driven principally by large natural catastrophe activity (Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria, Mexico earthquakes and Californian wildfires) and adverse attritional development on the Property and Marine lines, partly offset by a release on the Liability class related to the 2016 Ogden margin.
raw_causal_phrases: principally due to natural catastrophes (Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria and the Mexico earthquakes and Californian Wildfires) and adverse attritional development in prior year reserves on the Property and Marine classes
Large loss activity on the Marine and Special Lines classes, and adverse attritional loss development on the Property and Marine lines further deteriorated the results
improvement on the Liability class driven by the release of the 2016 Ogden margin

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior-year movement is not explicitly stated in the notes as a single gross figure. The report provides a net prior-year deterioration (GBP 11.547k) in narrative (net of reinsurance). A gross prior-year movement was calculated from the gross claims development table (notes) - that calculation is used here. Prior-year net figure from narrative was retained in exact_reserve_text for transparency.
